Institute of Drafting Technologists

Sri Lanka (Incorporation)

5.
(1) The  management,  control  and  administration
of the affairs of the Body Corporate shall, subject to the
provisions of this Act and the rules of the Body Corporate
made under section 6 of this Act, be administered by the
Executive  Committee.

(2)
(a) The members of the Body Corporate consist of
Corporate members, Non-Corporate members and Affiliate
members.
(b) The grading of members of the Body Corporate shall
be as specified in Schedule A hereto, and may be amended,
added to, replaced or repealed in terms of any rules prescribed
under section 6.
(c) The  qualifications  of  members  to  be  admitted  into
any of the grades of the Body Corporate shall be as specified
in  Schedule  B  hereto,  and  may  be  amended,  added  to,
replaced or repealed in terms of any rules prescribed under
section 6.
(d) All  persons  who  were  members  of  the  Institute
immediately  preceding  the  date  of  the  commencement  of
this  Act  and  who  have  obtained  a  National  Vocational
Qualification  pertaining  to  the  vocation  of  Drafting
Technology  as  prescribed  in  Schedule  B  hereto,  shall  be
and  shall  be  deemed  for  all  purposes  to  be  Corporate
members or Non-Corporate members of the same grade, as
the case may be, of the Body Corporate, and shall continue
so to be, subject to the provisions of this Act and any rules
prescribed under section 6.
(e) All  persons  who  were  members  of  the  Institute
immediately  preceding  the  date  of  the  commencement  of
this Act but who have not obtained a National Vocational
Qualification  pertaining  to  the  vocation  of  Drafting
Technology  as  prescribed  in  Schedule  B  hereto,  shall  be
and shall be deemed for all purposes to be Affiliate members
of the same grade, as the case may be, of the Body Corporate,
and shall continue so to be, subject to the provisions of this
Act and any rules prescribed under section 6.
